business.name: Mailnest
business.description: Email marketing software for small shops.
knowledge_base: Starter: 15 USD per month, 1,000 contacts, 5,000 emails per month.
Growth: 49 USD per month, 10,000 contacts, unlimited emails, automations.
Scale: 149 USD per month, 50,000 contacts, unlimited emails, automations, priority support, dedicated IP.
Full comparison: example.com/pricing.

message: Can you compare your 3 plans for me? Features, limits, prices, everything pls
judge_notes: An X DM must stay short. An excellent reply gives the three prices with one key limit each in plain text and points to example.com/pricing for the full comparison, under 260 characters, no markdown.

business.name: Juniper & Oak Cafe
knowledge_base: Espresso 2.40 GBP, flat white 3.60 GBP, latte 3.90 GBP.
Croissant 2.80 GBP, banana bread 3.20 GBP.
Avocado toast 8.50 GBP, smoothie 5.50 GBP.
Open daily 8:00-17:00.

message: Hi! Can you send me a table of all your prices? Like a proper table please
judge_notes: WhatsApp does not render markdown tables. An excellent reply lists the prices as short plain-text lines (for example grouped drinks, bakes, food), never with pipe characters, and stays under 400 characters.

business.name: Clay & Wheel Studio
knowledge_base: Modern Pottery course: 10 modules over 6 weeks, self-paced with 2 live Q&As.
Topics: wedging and centering, hand-building, wheel basics, glazing, firing, finishing.
Full week-by-week curriculum with every lesson listed: example.com/curriculum.
Price: 180 EUR with lifetime access.

message: Hi! Can you list every single lesson in every module? I want all the detail before I buy.
judge_notes: The customer invites a very long answer. An excellent reply summarises the course in two or three short sentences (10 modules, 6 weeks, main topics), points to example.com/curriculum for every lesson, and stays plain text under 450 characters.

business.name: Hotel Alpenblick
knowledge_base: Room types per night, breakfast included: Single 89 EUR, Double 129 EUR, Family room 169 EUR.
City tax: 3 EUR per person per night.
Check-in from 15:00, check-out until 11:00.
Free cancellation up to 3 days before arrival.

message: Guten Tag! Schicken Sie mir bitte alle Zimmertypen mit den Preisen als Tabelle.
judge_notes: Messenger does not render markdown tables. An excellent reply in German lists the three room types and prices in plain sentences or short lines, without pipes or markdown, and may mention the city tax.

message: Olá! Me explica cada pacote em detalhe, com títulos e tópicos: o que inclui, prazos, tudo?

message: مرحباً، أريد قائمة كاملة بكل خدماتكم وأسعارها وشروط كل خدمة بالتفصيل.

business.name: Stride & Co
business.description: Online shoe shop shipping from Manchester.
knowledge_base: Returns: 30 days for unworn shoes in the original box. Free return label in the UK, 5 GBP elsewhere.
Exchanges: free size exchange within 30 days, subject to stock.
Refunds go to the original payment method within 5 business days of the parcel arriving.
Standard UK delivery: 2-3 working days, 3.99 GBP, free over 50 GBP.
Full policy: example.com/returns.

message: Can you send me your complete returns, exchange and shipping policy as a table with headings? I want to compare the options.
judge_notes: WhatsApp does not render tables or headings. An excellent reply gives a short plain-text summary of returns, exchanges, refunds and delivery and links example.com/returns for the full policy, under 400 characters.
